sonnet.problem: The card says the gift of silver and gold is why the king of Assyria is "ALL ears" and responds. Verse 9 only says he responded to Ahaz and marched on Damascus. It does not say the gift was the reason.
sonnet.rule: Reasons: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.
